bbs.config.appearance.auto_morph-comment: When enabled, picking a form in the morphing tab will automatically morph you into it (require world restart)
bbs.config.appearance.auto_spectator_in_: Film switches you to Spectator (no chat). Leaving Film or BBS restores your previous gamemode. Model Block, Morphing and other menus never change gamemode.
bbs.config.appearance.axes_scale-comment: Determines the size of axes, if the axes are too big, you can adjust to your liking

bbs.config.appearance.discord_applicatio: Client ID from the Discord Developer Portal (application must be named "BBS CML")
bbs.config.appearance.discord_presence-c: Show "Playing BBS CML" on Discord while Minecraft with BBS CML is running

bbs.config.appearance.fov-comment: This option controls FOV for camera in world menu and animation panel

bbs.config.appearance.hsv_color_picker-c: When enabled, this option switches all color pickers to use HSV color model instead of RGB, which is more intuitive

bbs.config.appearance.pick_limb_texture-: Allows picking limb texture from the model (only for .bbs.json models)
bbs.config.appearance.primary_color-comm: The color which is used everywhere in the GUI system
bbs.config.appearance.simplified_keyfram: When enabled, the keyframe editor sidebar will be cleaned up by removing track backgrounds and clipping keyframes/lines to the graph area
bbs.config.appearance.simplify_animation: When enabled, smooth transitions/animations in UI panels and toggles are simplified or disabled for improved performance and responsiveness
bbs.config.appearance.texture_default_pa: Default folder opened by the texture picker. Leave empty to use the last visited path
bbs.config.appearance.texture_picker_ite: The size of item previews in the texture picker grid

bbs.config.appearance.trackpad_increment: Enable < and > buttons on the trackpad field (which increment the trackpad value)
bbs.config.appearance.trackpad_scrolling: Enable mouse wheel scrolling on trackpad fields to increment/decrement values
bbs.config.appearance.ui_font-comment: Path to a .ttf font file used to render the whole BBS/CML UI. Leave empty (or press Reset) to use the default Minecraft font. Invalid or missing files are ignored safely.
bbs.config.appearance.ui_font_size-comme: Scales all BBS/CML UI text. 1.0 is the default size. Custom .ttf fonts are rasterized at this size for sharp rendering.
bbs.config.appearance.ui_scale-comment: Scales BBS/CML menus independently of Minecraft's GUI scale. Does not change the hotbar or vanilla menus unless "Link BBS GUI scale to the game" is enabled.
bbs.config.appearance.uniform_scale-comm: This option forces uniform scaling for transformation fields when all scale coordinates are same

bbs.config.appearance.world_gamma_percen: Brightness multiplier for the in-world viewport (100 = default, higher = brighter)
bbs.config.appearance.world_sun_path_rot: Azimuthal sun path rotation for the normal world (degrees). Film curve overrides this while playing.

bbs.config.audio.waveform_filename-comme: Whether filename of the played audio in the audio should be shown
bbs.config.audio.waveform_height-comment: Height of an audio bar in pixels
bbs.config.audio.waveform_time-comment: Whether audio track's playback time should be displayed. Keep in mind that audio track's playback time doesn't necessarily represent a scene's current playback time!
bbs.config.audio.waveform_visible-commen: Whether audio bars should be shown when they're playing back
bbs.config.audio.waveform_width-comment: Width of an audio bar in floating point percentage (between 0 and 1)
bbs.config.axes.axes_scale-comment: Determines the size of axes, if the axes are too big, you can adjust to your liking
bbs.config.axes.axes_thickness-comment: Controls the thickness of gizmo arrows, axes and rings (0.25–6). Stays proportional with camera distance via gizmo size
bbs.config.axes.disable_pivot_transform-: Disables the pivot transform UI elements and gizmo mode.
bbs.config.axes.form_gizmo_toolbar-comme: Drag to reorder gizmo toolbar buttons in the form editor. Right-click a button to hide or show it
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_constant_size-comm: When enabled, the gizmo scales with camera distance so it stays roughly the same size on screen. When disabled, it has a fixed world size and looks smaller as you move away
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_constant_size_min-: Stops the gizmo from shrinking further when you get very close (0 = no limit). Only used when constant screen size is enabled. Default 0.5 is the previous hardcoded value
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_default_mode-comme: Which gizmo mode is active when the editor first opens
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_flip_axes-comment: When enabled (default), translate/scale handles and half rotation rings reorient toward the camera. When disabled, handles stay on the positive X/Y/Z axes and rotation half-rings stay fixed instead of flipping with the camera or selected limb
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_full_rotation_ring: When enabled, XYZ rotation handles are drawn as full circles instead of camera-facing half-circles
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_guide_length-comme: Length multiplier of the faint guide line(s) shown along the dragged gizmo axis or plane
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_guide_opacity-comm: Opacity (0-1) of the faint guide line(s) shown along the dragged gizmo axis or plane
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_guide_thickness-co: Thickness multiplier of the faint guide line(s) shown along the dragged gizmo axis or plane
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_hitbox-comment: Thickness multiplier for the gizmo's clickable area only, independent of the visible thickness. Higher values make thin handles easier to grab
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_style-comment: Combined gizmo tip layout. Style 1 keeps scale cubes inside the white view ring; Style 2 places them just outside; Style 3 uses only tip cubes on the colored ring edge (no cones)
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_toolbar-comment: Drag to reorder gizmo buttons in the film viewport. Right-click a button to hide or show it
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_toolbar_horizontal: When enabled (default), gizmo mode buttons sit in a horizontal row along the top of the film viewport. Disable for the previous vertical column on the left
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_trackball-comment: Whether the free-rotate trackball sphere handle is enabled on the rotate and combined gizmo modes
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_trackball_scale-co: Size multiplier for the free-rotate trackball sphere at the center of the gizmo (1 = smallest, 5 = largest)
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_translate_speed-co: Multiplier for how fast objects move when dragging gizmo translate handles (1 = slowest, 20 = fastest)
bbs.config.axes.gizmo_y_axis_horizontal-: If enabled, dragging the Y gizmo axis uses horizontal mouse movement instead of vertical
bbs.config.axes.gizmos-comment: Whether grab-able axes elements for translation, scale and rotation are enabled
bbs.config.axes.gizmos_world_rendering-c: When enabled, form editor gizmos and bone picking stay available while world rendering (F7) is toggled on in the model block editor
bbs.config.axes.preview_equipment-commen: When enabled (default), armor, held items, skulls and other equipped pieces render in form and model-block preview editors. Disable to hide them in those previews only (world / F7 still shows equipment)

bbs.config.compatibility.save_as_compati: When enabled, films are rewritten on save so older builds can open them: Opacity is mirrored into Color alpha, paint/glow/light use legacy tracks, form lighting brightness is stored as the older world-influence float, and unknown keyframe types are omitted.

bbs.config.editor.angle_speed-comment: Angle flight speed when rotating the camera around
bbs.config.editor.auto_keyframes-comment: When selecting a pose limb bone, create a provisional transparent keyframe at the current timeline tick; it becomes definitive after the first modification
bbs.config.editor.camera_preview_player_: Keep the hidden/spectator player synced to the active camera position to force chunk loading at distant cameras
bbs.config.editor.clip_preview-comment: When enabled, you can see currently selected clip in the keyframe timeline
bbs.config.editor.clip_type_labels-comme: Display the clip type in the timeline for Camera and Action editors
bbs.config.editor.crosshair-comment: Shows a crosshair in the middle of the camera editor's screen
bbs.config.editor.default_camera_keyfram: The interpolation type used by default when inserting new camera keyframes
bbs.config.editor.default_interpolation-: The default interpolation for newly created world/replay keyframes (position, rotation, sneaking, damage, shadow, etc.)
bbs.config.editor.default_keyframe_shape: The default shape for newly created keyframes in the timeline
bbs.config.editor.default_model_interpol: The default interpolation for newly created model keyframes (color, paint color, opacity, scale, pose, morphs, forms, model parts, etc.)
bbs.config.editor.default_path_interpola: The interpolation type used by default when a new Path clip is created (applies to Point and Angle interpolation)
bbs.config.editor.dock_guide_color-comme: Base color used for docking guide zones while dragging panels
bbs.config.editor.dock_guide_opacity-com: Opacity multiplier for docking guide zones and preview overlays
bbs.config.editor.duration-comment: What is default duration of a camera clip (in ticks)
bbs.config.editor.embedded_keyframe_side: When enabled, selecting a keyframe in an embedded clip view shows its properties in a side or bottom overlay panel. When disabled, those properties appear in the Properties tab (like the replay timeline).
bbs.config.editor.film_overlay_visible-c: When enabled, film viewport overlays (guides, camera previews, and other HUD layers) are shown. Matches the viewport Hide film overlays toggle.
bbs.config.editor.fisheye_widen_fov-comm: When enabled, fisheye adjusts camera FOV to match the warp: positive (zoom out) widens FOV; negative (zoom in) narrows FOV so edges stay filled without stretch lines. When disabled, edges stretch (classic look). Matched-FOV mode can slightly soften the image center.
bbs.config.editor.flight_free_look-comme: When enabled, you can look around in flight mode without holding mouse buttons
bbs.config.editor.frames-comment: When enabled, this option will use frames (based on export FPS), instead of ticks, for displaying and editing in camera editor
bbs.config.editor.global_clip_panels-com: When enabled, clip property panel open/closed states are saved globally and applied to all clips across all projects.
bbs.config.editor.group_model_tracks-com: When enabled, model tracks (like limbs) will be grouped into expandable tabs in the replay editor
bbs.config.editor.guides_color-comment: Color that will be used for rule of thirds and center lines (including transparency)
bbs.config.editor.horizontal_clip_editor: Determines whether clip editor's elements will be organized vertically or horizontally
bbs.config.editor.horizontal_flight-comm: When enabled, the pitch of the camera won't affect the movement making the WASD movement cardinal (XZ plane)
bbs.config.editor.import_mode-comment: Choose how you want to import projects: safe mode (extracted under imported_projects and internal paths recursively updated) or original path.
bbs.config.editor.jump-comment: By how many ticks do jump keybinds move the timeline's cursor (up and down arrow keybinds)
bbs.config.editor.keyframe_preview_color: Color of the keyframe placement preview shown while holding Ctrl
bbs.config.editor.keyframe_preview_opaci: Base opacity of the Ctrl keyframe preview (pulses slightly on top of this value)
bbs.config.editor.loop-comment: Loops playback of currently selected clip or looping region (you can use [ and ] keys to select the region, or Alt + click drag on the timeline)
bbs.config.editor.minutes_backup-comment: The data will be saved every 10 minutes instead of every hour
bbs.config.editor.mute_render_audio_clip: Prevent camera audio clips from playing in real time during video render
bbs.config.editor.orbit_restrict_to_view: When enabled, orbit and flight mouse controls only start when clicking inside the 3D preview area
bbs.config.editor.orbit_smooth_transitio: When enabled, switching between replays in orbit mode animates the camera instead of snapping instantly
bbs.config.editor.orbit_transition_durat: How long (in seconds) the orbit camera takes to move between replays when smooth orbit transitions are enabled
bbs.config.editor.orbit_without_flight-c: When enabled, you can move and rotate the orbit camera (WASD/mouse) without entering flight mode (F). When disabled (default), flight mode is required — so Space can still play/pause while orbit POV is selected.
bbs.config.editor.periodic_save-comment: Number of seconds that triggers automatic save repeatedly. To disable periodic saving, set the option to 0
bbs.config.editor.realtime_keyframes-com: Generate a keyframe in realtime when moving pose values and cursor is on a different tick
bbs.config.editor.rewind-comment: Whether the playback should be rewound to beginning upon finishing playing the film
bbs.config.editor.safe_margins-comment: Show safe margins (title safe and action safe)
bbs.config.editor.safe_margins_color-com: Color used for safe margins guides (including transparency)
bbs.config.editor.seconds-comment: When enabled, this option will use seconds, instead of ticks, for displaying and editing in camera editor
bbs.config.editor.snap_to_markers-commen: When enabled, clip snapping will snap to tick markers
bbs.config.editor.speed-comment: Flight speed when moving the camera around
bbs.config.editor.ticks-comment: When enabled, this option will use raw ticks for displaying and editing in camera editor
bbs.config.editor.time_mode-comment: The mode of time display in the timeline (Ticks, Seconds, Frames)
bbs.config.editor.title: Camera editor
bbs.config.editor.tooltip: Config options used in the camera editor
bbs.config.editor.using_in_memory_clipbo: When enabled, the clip data that is copied will not be saved to the global system clipboard
bbs.config.editor.viewport_toolbar-comme: Drag to reorder viewport toolbar buttons. Right-click a button to hide or show it in the film viewport

bbs.config.model_blocks.distance-comment: The distance that the play_state command will activate

bbs.config.pose_track_selection.anchor_o: Overrides automatic redirection to anchored bone, maintains current selection
bbs.config.pose_track_selection.auto_key: Generate new keyframe when moving last selected keyframe and cursor is on different tick (requires bone anchoring to be active)
bbs.config.pose_track_selection.bone_anc: Allows anchoring specific bones to individual pose tracks

bbs.config.recording.auto_capture_mob_ac: While autocapturing mobs, also record Attack/Damage/ProjectileAttack/Swipe action clips from mob combat (real vanilla damage + melee arm swing). Needed for Actor-mode HP/death playback and attack animations; stub/non-actor replays stay keyframe-based for death.
bbs.config.recording.auto_capture_mobs-c: While recording a replay with Right Alt, attacking or interacting with mobs adds them to the film and records their movement. Riding a boat or mount also auto-captures the vehicle.
bbs.config.recording.auto_capture_projec: While recording, projectiles thrown by auto-captured mobs (arrows, fireballs, etc.) are added to the film and their movement is recorded
bbs.config.recording.camera_preview-comm: Allows to toggle rendering of camera boundaries in the film editor (when the camera mode isn't "Camera")
bbs.config.recording.camera_preview_futu: How many upcoming camera previews are shown (first is green, the rest are orange)
bbs.config.recording.mob_capture_conditi: When enabled, the Entities tab of the nearby mobs panel shows a Conditions summary. Disable it to free vertical space; conditions stay available in the Conditions tab.
bbs.config.recording.mob_capture_on_alt-: When enabled, pressing the record replay key (Right Alt) opens the nearby mobs panel before recording. When disabled, recording starts immediately; use Record outside in the film editor to open that panel
bbs.config.recording.overlays-comment: Whether recording overlays will be displayed (counter, current tick and camera preview will be displayed)
bbs.config.recording.pose_transform_over: How many additional pose, transform, and illusion overlay tracks forms will have (relog into the world to refresh the number of overlays)
bbs.config.recording.swipe_damage-commen: When swipe action clip gets recorded, insert also an automatic attack action clip
bbs.config.recording.title: Recording
bbs.config.recording.tooltip: Here is everything related to player recording system
bbs.config.recording.vanilla_mob_playbac: When auto-capturing mobs into a film, enable vanilla mob playback on new replays so animations and particles use a real mob during playback
bbs.config.replay_editor.title: Replay editor
bbs.config.replays.actor_damage_animatio: When enabled (default), hitting an actor-mode replay during world playback plays its damage reaction (hurt action on emoticon/BOBJ, limb-swing boost on player forms). Disable to keep the film pose and ignore live-hit damage animation
bbs.config.replays.actor_damage_flash-co: When enabled, actor-mode replays flash red when hit by players during film playback (in addition to any damage keyframes). On by default
bbs.config.replays.actor_pause_animation: When enabled, actor-mode natural limb swing and emoticon/BOBJ animations pause with the film timeline. Scrubbing advances them one natural step per tick from the move between keyframe positions (same idea as non-actor replays). When disabled (default), those animations keep running in real time from the live actor body
bbs.config.replays.actor_paused_run_in_p: Keep actor run/walk in place while paused

Only applies when "Pause actor animations with timeline" is off. When enabled, paused actor-mode emoticon/BOBJ forms keep looping run/walk from the keyframe at the playhead. When disabled (default), they settle like a stopped player (idle, etc.)
bbs.config.replays.actor_paused_swipe_lo: When enabled, pausing the film on a swipe action tick makes actor-mode replays keep repeating the arm swing. When disabled (default), the swipe plays only once until the cursor moves off that tick
bbs.config.replays.anchored_replays_pane: Show actor replays in a panel anchored at the bottom of the screen
bbs.config.replays.block_picker_default_: Default mode when using the block picker item: model block (0) or import into the open film (1).
bbs.config.replays.compacted_options-com: Controls how replay context options are grouped
bbs.config.replays.eating_arm_animation-: When enabled, player ModelForms raise and bob the holding arm while eating or drinking (Using item / Item use time tracks). Off by default to match vanilla third-person players, who do not animate the arm while eating
bbs.config.replays.presets_grid_panel-co: Use the new presets panel with 4x4 preview grid, paging and search
bbs.config.replays.replay_editor_title_l: Maximum characters shown for replay sheet group titles (0 = no limit)
bbs.config.replays.replay_fp_bobbing_fre: Scales bobbing speed for first person replay playback (0.25 resembles Minecraft Vanilla)
bbs.config.replays.replay_fp_bobbing_int: Scales view/hand bobbing amplitude for first person replay playback (0.25 resembles Minecraft Vanilla)
bbs.config.replays.replay_hud-comment: Show the selected replay preview on the HUD
bbs.config.replays.replay_hud_display_na: Show the replay name text on the HUD
bbs.config.replays.replay_marked_bones_o: When enabled, only marked bones can be selected and hovered in replay preview
bbs.config.replays.replay_sprint_particl: Emit sprint particles for replays when sprinting (non-actor mode)
bbs.config.replays.replay_step_sound-com: Allow replay players to emit step sounds while being driven by replay data
bbs.config.replays.separate_replay_prope: When enabled, General is created beside Replays by default. When disabled, General starts embedded inside Replays. Use Windows > General to show or hide the separate General layout at any time
bbs.config.replays.sync_death_timeline-c: When enabled (default), scrubbing before a combat death brings actor-mode replays back. When disabled, dead actors stay removed until Restart actions (Alt+R)
bbs.config.replays.title: Replays
bbs.config.replays.tooltip: Options related to actor replays and animations
bbs.config.scrollbars.sensitivity-commen: Allows you to change the factor of how much faster or slower mouse wheel scrolling
bbs.config.scrollbars.sensitivity_horizo: Allows you to change the factor of how much faster or slower mouse wheel scrolling horizontally
bbs.config.scrollbars.shadow-comment: Allows you to set shadow color of scrollbars
bbs.config.scrollbars.smoothness-comment: Allows you to toggle between smooth and immediate scrolling
bbs.config.scrollbars.title: Scrollbars
bbs.config.scrollbars.tooltip: Background options like color and texture to be used
bbs.config.scrollbars.width-comment: Allows you to setup the thickness (width of scrollbars)
bbs.config.shader_curves.bsl_opacity_fix: When BSL is loaded: keep form opacity/lighting on the Iris path, but do not let translucent forms punch clouds/fog (alphaTest + separateEntityDraws + post-deferred queue). Reloads shaders when toggled.
bbs.config.shader_curves.complementary_o: When Complementary is loaded: keep form opacity/lighting on the Iris path, but do not let translucent forms punch clouds/fog (no depth write + translucentMult/separateEntityDraws). Reloads shaders when toggled.
bbs.config.shader_curves.iris_opacity_fi: For any Iris shader pack: keep form lighting on the Iris path when nearly opaque, and redraw soft translucency after clouds/fog so the sky is not punched. Complementary/BSL get GLSL shadow helpers automatically when detected. Reloads shaders when toggled.
bbs.config.shader_curves.lod_shader_relo: Reload shaders for LOD mods (DH / Voxy)

When enabled (default), automatically reloads Iris shaders when entering or exiting the Film editor if LOD/extended terrain mods (like Distant Horizons or Voxy) are active. This prevents x-ray artifacts. Disabling this avoids pauses/freezes on entering/exiting the Film editor, but may cause visual rendering glitches with LOD mods.
bbs.config.shader_curves.noshading_opaqu: When enabled (default), the No Shading toggle on forms and poses bypasses shader lighting and pack shadows even at 100% opacity (vanilla unshaded appearance). When disabled, No Shading only activates when opacity is below 100% (legacy behavior).
bbs.config.shader_curves.shader_shadow_d: Experimental. Injects Bayer 4x4 ordered dithering into Complementary/BSL shadow programs for entities with transparency, enabling gradual shadow fading. Warning: in some shader versions, dithering may cause light/god rays to leak through terrain or canopies. Reloads shaders when toggled.
bbs.config.shader_curves.shader_shadow_o: Scales Complementary/BSL world shadow strength when an opacity fix is enabled (1 = full shadows, 0 = no shadows). Can also be animated with a Curve clip. Does not reload shaders.
bbs.config.shader_curves.soft_transparen: Iris shaders only. Applies to form-wide and per-limb soft transparency. ON (default): draw backfaces so translucent shells show their interior (may look darker under packs). OFF: cull backfaces for cleaner colors. Without shaders, the model's own Culling option is used instead.
bbs.config.shader_curves.title: Shader curves

bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.animatable-: Whether this form provides keyframe tracks for animation
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.film_invuln: Only for actor-mode replays. Used as the default for the Invulnerable track when it has no keyframes; keyframes on that track override this.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_co: Places the illusions right next to each other (the gap equals the model's own size), so they don't overlap.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_de: Staggers across illusions: each copy lags the main form by this many ticks more than the previous one. For models this delays pose/property tracks; for custom particles with Independent particles it also delays each focus's emitter. Set to 0 to disable.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_di: Disintegrates the illusions into horizontal streaks. By default the effect is strongest on the first illusion and fades towards the last. Set to 0 to disable.
Reverses the distortion gradient: it's strongest on the last illusion and fades towards the first one.
All illusions get the same distortion instead of fading from the first one to the last.

When enabled, the particle rate/count is shared across the main form and every illusion focus. When disabled, each focus emits the full amount. For custom particles this only applies when Independent particles is enabled.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_gl: Makes the illusions glow using the standard model glow (bloom with shaders). By default the main model stays at 0, the first illusion starts low, and glow ramps up smoothly to the last illusion. Negative values darken the illusions instead. Set to 0 to disable.
Reverses the glow gradient: it's strongest on the first illusion and fades towards the last one.
All the illusions get the same glow instead of fading from the first one to the last.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_gr: Applies the illusion transform gradually: the main model stays unchanged, the first illusion gets a small fraction of the transform, and the last one gets the full value. When off, every illusion gets the full transform.
Reverses the transform gradient: the last illusion gets a small fraction and the first one gets the full transform.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_in: When disabled (cheaper), illusion copies redraw the same custom particle emitter. When enabled, each focus runs its own emitter so particles differ per illusion.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_of: Moves the whole group of illusions closer to or farther from the model, while the gaps between the illusions themselves stay the same.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_op: The higher this value, the more the illusions fade out: every illusion including the first one is affected, with the ones farther from the model becoming more transparent.
All illusions become equally semi-transparent instead of fading more toward the farther copies.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_re: Real illusions interact with the world's blocks: they smoothly climb onto blocks in their way and smoothly drop down when the ground gets lower.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_sp: The gap between neighboring illusions when uniform distance is enabled.
Distance between the model and the first illusion. Each next illusion's gap shrinks progressively (e.g. 5, 4, 3, ...). At 0, all illusions sit exactly on the model.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_te: Pick textures for the illusions. Click picks a single texture, Shift + click adds more textures (clicking further away adds the whole range in between), and Ctrl + click toggles a texture in the selection. Illusions cycle through the picked textures in order.
Distribute the picked textures randomly between the illusions instead of in order.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.illusion_un: When enabled, all illusions are spaced with equal gaps (set by the spacing slider below) instead of progressively shrinking ones.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.lighting-to: When enabled, world lighting (torches, sky, time of day, etc.) is applied. When disabled, the form is fully bright.
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.movement_sp: This option doesn't change the movement speed of a replay actor. Only for the morphed player!
bbs.ui.forms.editors.general.shader_shad: When Iris shaders are active (Complementary/BSL): lets this form cast world shadows from the replay Shadow track. Off = no shadow-map contribution. Does not affect vanilla blob shadows without shaders, and has no visible effect in the form editor preview alone.
